name: PanVK Kbase — RC5-universal-111
displayVersion: RC5-universal-111 (Mesa 5a07217f, csf-v11 018-222 + jm-v9 + jm-v7 + jm-v7-wip 0006-0092; v6/v7/v9/v10/v11 in one .so)
author: abhay-byte
description: Experimental PanVK driver for Mali GPUs on mali_kbase: Bifrost JM v6/v7, Valhall JM v9 and CSF v10-v14 in one .so. RC5-universal-111 fixes two v9 (Mali-G78 class) issues: larger growable tiler heaps for GS/tessellation-heavy render passes, and correct base instance and indirect triangle fans on large gpu_prerast draws. Bundled in this APK.
